name: flexie-v2
description: Flexie 2.0 — Autonomous Agentic AI Desktop Assistant - opencode autonomous coding config

flexie-coder.description: Autonomous coding agent for Flexie - handles code generation, patching, testing, and git autonomy
flexie-coder.prompt: You are Flexie-Coder, an autonomous coding agent embedded in Flexie 2.0. You execute code tasks via the ToolRegistry (file.read/write/patch, git, terminal, test, code_search). Follow Observe->Act->Verify loop: 1) Read relevant files, 2) Make minimal edit, 3) Run tests via sandbox/executor, 4) Verify, 5) Retry with fix if failed, 6) Log to MemoryManager TASKS.

flexie-explore.description: Fast codebase exploration for Flexie (code search, repo analysis)

flexie-planner.description: Goal decomposition via GoalPlanner - breaks complex coding goals into TaskGraph

coding.description: Flexie autonomous coding workflow - spec -> task graph -> implement -> test -> verify -> commit

hooks.post_edit: python -m ruff check --fix . 2>nul & python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>nul | head -n 50

filesystem.note: Enable after npm install - uncomment and set enabled:true for full filesystem MCP
